# /fc:review

[← Back to commands](../commands.md)

<!-- Generated by skills/ai-layout/scripts/sync-docs.js from commands/review.md; do not edit. Edit docs/commands/_notes/review.md instead. -->

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Claude name | `/fc:review` |
| Codex name | `$fc-review` |
| Kind | Project task — loads `ai-factory/tasks/review.md` from your repo, so it needs an adopted workspace |
| Description | Review the selected change, including uncommitted work by default |
| Arguments | `[working-tree\|branch\|supplied diff and context]` |

## Usage

Run `/fc:review` before committing. The read-only `reviewer` subagent reviews the selected change
against the named spec and plan, or the acceptance checklist for a small change, and the coding
standards and dont-touch rules. It checks correctness, scope, tests, spec drift, boundaries,
security and operability and, where an assessment in `ai-factory/risks/` applies, whether the
change implements its mitigations. It does not comment on formatting.

- **Default scope: the working tree.** Staged and unstaged changes plus relevant nonignored untracked
  files. It never stages anything and never reads ignored secrets.
- **`branch`** reviews the committed branch.
- **A supplied diff** is reviewed as given, never replaced with another diff.

The result is one JSON object: the verdict (`approve` or `request_changes`), the findings (each with
severity, file, line, issue and suggestion) and a summary that names the scope and the reviewed
paths. With artifact contracts enabled, an artifact that is not valid is reported as a finding. An in-session review is a self-check, not an independent opinion.
Only the headless `make -f ai-factory/make/ai.mk review DELIVERY=<id>` records independent review
evidence. With artifact contracts enabled, [`/fc:report`](report.md) then assembles the completion
report.

See also: [Feature workflow: Review](../workflows/feature.md#9-review),
[The review gate](../headless-ci.md#the-review-gate) and
[workflow.md §6](../../ai-factory/docs/workflow.md#6-headless-for-ci).

## Examples

```
/fc:review
/fc:review branch
/fc:review working-tree against ai-factory/plans/PMB-003-csv-export.md
```

## Writes

Nothing. Its output is the JSON verdict.

## Refuses or asks

- It fixes nothing it finds and never changes the index.
- It never collects or reads `ai-factory/runs/tmp/worktrees/`, which holds `/fc:loop`'s temporary
  worktrees.
- It never runs `make -f ai-factory/make/ai.mk review`: a review never launches another. When an
  assurance preset requires independent review, the summary says this interactive review does not
  satisfy that requirement.
- When the repo has no `ai-factory/` workspace, it reports that it needs `/fc:adopt-sdlc`.
